summary: Backend testing of the NEW Agent role workflow (OSEA/SignalCitoyen). 31/31 pytest cases passed (100%). All new agent endpoints behave as specified: agent login propagates team_id, GET /api/agent/reports is correctly RBAC-scoped (agent-only, filtered by team_id), start-intervention transitions assigned→processing with correct 400/403/404 errors, resolve enforces mandatory proof_photos and sets resolved_by + agent_notes, admin reopen transitions resolved→assigned with appended admin_notes (RÉOUVERTURE prefix + timestamp). Regression OK: auth, reports CRUD, auto-routing (Cocody/water → EQUIPE_EAU_COCODY, urgent_critique), PUT /reports/{id}, notifications inbox, scheduler started in logs. New Report fields (proof_photos, agent_notes, resolved_by) are returned everywhere. Citizen receives notifications on every status transition.

minor.issue: Duplicate route declaration. Two functions named get_stats are decorated for the same path: server.py:798 (full implementation) and server.py:1075 (empty body with no return). FastAPI keeps the first registered route so behaviour is correct, but the dead duplicate must be removed to avoid future regressions.

Empty/whitespace reason check (server.py:1038) is performed AFTER the status check. Combined with Pydantic requiring reason as a str, behaviour is correct, but consider validating with Pydantic Field(min_length=1) for cleaner 422 semantics.

action_items: Remove the duplicate empty get_stats function at server.py:1075-1079 (dead code, confusing).

Optional: bcrypt warning 'AttributeError: module bcrypt has no attribute __about__' shows in backend.err.log on startup. Non-blocking (passlib still works) but consider pinning bcrypt<4.1 or upgrading passlib.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1177 lines and mixes models, helpers, notification orchestrator, scheduler, and routes. Recommend splitting into modules (models/, services/notifications.py, services/routing.py, routes/agent.py, routes/reports.py).
Duplicate route handler get_stats at line 1075 has no body/return - dead code.
datetime arithmetic at server.py:487 uses report.get('created_at').replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) - relies on naive datetimes from Mongo. Safer to store tz-aware dates consistently.
_push_client is created at import time (server.py:45); fine for current behaviour but should be moved into FastAPI lifespan for cleaner shutdown.
seed_data_creation: Tests create fresh reports (description prefixed with 'TEST_agent_workflow') as the citoyen@test.com account; existing seeded agent users (agent.cocody, agent.adjame) were used as-is. No production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All agent workflow endpoints (GET /api/agent/reports, POST /api/reports/{id}/start-intervention, /resolve, /reopen) are fully functional and covered by /app/backend/tests/test_agent_workflow.py. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_agent_workflow.py -v. The duplicate get_stats route should be cleaned up but does not affect functionality.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no functional bug found. The duplicate get_stats is harmless because FastAPI matches the first registered route, but should be removed for code hygiene.
